description: Sets 2025 diversity and inclusion budget at $15,100.
Allocates $11,000 for education and awareness sponsorships.
Approved $1,000 for Pleasant Hill, $500 for Sip of Culture.

chips.text: City staff confirmed underspending has not led to reduced future funding.
Committee members questioned the balance of funding amounts versus number of sponsorships.
Funding supports diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives for smaller groups.
Committee committed to maximizing the $15,100 budget for community initiatives.
